title: Delete the retired Secrets Manager OperatorKey and ModelGatewaySigningKey secrets after the SSM move is verified
description: After PR 634 (SSM SecureString creator) is deployed and verified in development, staging and production, run aws cloudformation list-imports on the operator-key-secret-arn exports, then remove the retained secrets in a separate change; never in the same deploy as a consumer switch. Delete nothing without the owner's approval. Related story: a17075. Stays blocked until the SSM move is verified in all three environments.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Step A: list-imports on the three operator-key-secret-arn exports shows no importing stack; the signing key has no export; no references in AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web. PR 640 (to develop) removes the OperatorKey and ModelGatewaySigningKey constructs, the operator-key-secret-arn parameter and outputs, and dead test/doc rows. CI pending. Step B (staging/production release, then scheduled deletion with a 30 day window) follows only after develop deploy is verified.
